messages:
maria: quick sanity check — onboarding zeta-13b weights. CI is failing at the registry step (presign + checksum). anyone seen this pattern recently? :eyes:

alex: on it. can you paste the CI error (or link)?

maria: here's the failing log excerpt:
```
RegistryUploadError: presign failed (403) for https://registry.redwood/models/zeta-13b/weights/shard-0001.safetensors
Expected checksum sha256: 7f3e2... got: 9a1b4...
manifest.schema: v2 required but found v1
```

infra-bot: presign service returned 403 for request id c3f2-9b. Token TTL expired or origin access missing.

rachel: two quick suspects — (1) manifest schema mismatch (we upgraded the lint to v2 last week) and (2) shard file was mirrored from HF but the mirror job truncated the final block historically. can we check S3 object size + etag?

sameer: run `aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-registry --key models/zeta-13b/weights/shard-0001.safetensors` and check `ContentLength` + `ETag`. also confirm `manifest.json` has `sha256` populated.

alex: ran head-object, got:
```
ContentLength: 234567890
ETag: "9a1b4cdeff..."
metadata: origin=hf://huggingface.co/some/repo
```
So ETag != expected sha256 in manifest. looks like our mirror produced a different digest (ETag may be multipart md5 though).

maria: ah right — multipart uploads cause ETag != sha256. but CI expected sha256 in manifest and compares against actual computed sha256 on the object (we do `s3 cp` then `sha256sum`). maybe the mirror job left an older file or the manifest was generated before finalization.

rachel: can you paste the manifest fragment? small snippet is fine.

maria: manifest.json fragment:
```json
{"shards": [{"path": "weights/shard-0001.safetensors", "sha256": "7f3e2..."}], "schema": "v1"}
```

rachel: there's the problem: schema v1 + sha256 is stale. CI lint now requires `schema: v2` and a `checksum` object with `algorithm: "sha256"` and `value`. we need to re-run mirror job that computes sha256 after final put.

sameer: quick mitigation: update the CI to accept multipart-etag mismatch temporarily? not ideal. better to re-run mirror with single-part or compute sha256 after download and update manifest. which is faster here?

alex: fastest is to re-run the mirror job for that model (it will compute sha256 post-copy). I've kicked off the mirror job for zeta-13b/shard-0001. also granted `redwood-onboard` role read access to the HF origin so presign step should succeed.

maria: thanks — can you also give a temporary presign URL so CI can re-upload the corrected manifest? or should I push the manifest via the registry API?

alex: you can push via registry API. example curl to update manifest:
```bash
curl -X PUT -H "Authorization: Bearer $REG_API" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://registry.redwood/v1/models/zeta-13b/manifest -d @manifest.json
```
I'll watch for CI. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: rerun requested by @alex for pipeline zeta-13b-onboard (#3126505555). queued.

infra-bot: presign TTL extended for onboarding role by 10m (temporary) for request id c3f2-9b.

maria: pushed updated manifest (schema: v2, checksum algorithm: sha256, value matches computed). re-triggered CI manually. link: https://ci.redwood/runs/98765

ci-bot: pipeline started, registry step in progress.

ci-bot: registry step complete — checksum verified, presign succeeded. moving to tokenizer checks.

sameer: quick tokenizer note — tokenizer.json in this repo is missing `pad_offset` entry; that caused a small tokenization diff in our smoke eval earlier. can you add `pad_offset: 1` to tokenizer meta and re-upload?

rachel: I'll open a tiny config lint PR to add pad_offset and update `artifact_schema` comments. tagging @maria for review.

maria: thanks all. summary: mirror re-run + manifest update fixed presign/checksum; infra granted onboarding role read access; follow-up PR for tokenizer meta from @rachel. Marking this thread resolved for onboarding — will leave notes in the model onboarding doc. :white_check_mark:
